# Non-decoding state view

## Pull Request by @tomusdrw

and some other performance fixes.

Closes  #653

This PR introduces a non-decoding way to inspect the state. It's integrated via `view()` method on the state object (both `InMemoryState` and `SerializedState`). However accessing views with `InMemoryState` is not really expected to be faster, because we need to re-encode the objects.

Using views is much more cumbersome and requires a very specific usage pattern to actually be faster in benchmarks, so it does not mean we have to re-write the entire state transition to use views. Rather I think we should be introducing them carefully when it's actually beneficial as shown by profiler.

The usage is shown only in one place currently - `reports` transition, when we avoid accessing the entire `authPools` object.

Some additional performance improvements smuggled in this PR:
- [x] Introduce cache for decoded objects in state
- [x] fix sequence views dependent on context (they were incorrect due to codec being dependent on context, see also #306)
- [x] clean up too much data being passed to safrole seal
- [x] optimize extrinsic hash calculation (less allocation)
- [x] clean up recent blocks compatibility stuff

## Sequence Diagram(s)
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  actor CLI as convert CLI
  participant SPEC as ChainSpec
  participant TYPE as SupportedType
  participant Enc as Encoder
  participant Dec as Decoder

  CLI->>TYPE: resolve encode/decode
  alt encode/decode is function
    TYPE-->>CLI: provide fn(spec)
    CLI->>SPEC: pass spec
    SPEC-->>CLI: spec
    CLI->>Enc: use returned Encode
    CLI->>Dec: use returned Decode
  else static encode/decode
    TYPE-->>CLI: provide Encode/Decode
    CLI->>Enc: use Encode
    CLI->>Dec: use Decode
  end
  CLI->>CLI: output (Print/Bin), validate destination for Bin
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant User
  participant State as SerializedState
  participant View as SerializedStateView
  participant Backend as SerializedStateBackend
  participant Decoder

  User->>State: view()
  State-->>User: SerializedStateView
  User->>View: recentBlocksView()
  alt cached
    View-->>User: cached View
  else miss
    View->>Backend: get(key: recentBlocks)
    Backend-->>View: bytes
    View->>Decoder: new(bytes).withSpec(spec)
    Decoder-->>View: decode Codec.View
    View->>View: cache view
    View-->>User: View
  end
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  autonumber
  participant Node as Node init
  participant Block as Block.Codec
  participant Helper as reencodeAsView
  participant Enc as Encoder
  participant Dec as Decoder

  Node->>Helper: reencodeAsView(Block.Codec, block, spec)
  Helper->>Enc: encodeObject(Block.Codec, block, spec)
  Enc-->>Helper: encoded bytes
  Helper->>Dec: decodeObject(Block.Codec.View, bytes, spec)
  Dec-->>Helper: BlockView
  Helper-->>Node: BlockView
```
